biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature — wild-type TP53 should prompt re-review of HGSC diagnosis

biomarkers.name: BRCA1 / BRCA2 (germline and somatic)
biomarkers.clinical_use: PARP inhibitors (olaparib, niraparib, rucaparib) — SOLO1 (frontline maintenance in gBRCA), PAOLA-1 (with bev in HRD+), NOVA/PRIMA (niraparib maintenance). Cascade family testing

biomarkers.name: HRD (homologous recombination deficiency) status
biomarkers.type: genomic scar / LOH assay (Myriad myChoice, FoundationOne HRD)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~50% of HGSC (including BRCA-mutant and BRCA-wildtype HRD)
biomarkers.clinical_use: PARP inhibitor benefit — extends beyond BRCA-mutant to HRD-positive; guides maintenance therapy choice

biomarkers.name: BRIP1, RAD51C, RAD51D, PALB2 (HRR genes)
biomarkers.clinical_use: PARP inhibitor eligibility is strongest for BRCA-associated disease and HRD-positive tumors; these genes are established hereditary ovarian cancer susceptibility genes and support genetic counselling/testing

biomarkers.name: CCNE1 amplification
biomarkers.clinical_use: Hallmark HGSC driver/copy-number event, typically mutually exclusive with BRCA-associated HRD; associated with primary platinum/PARP resistance and adverse prognosis; not yet a routine standard-of-care companion biomarker

biomarkers.name: CA-125
biomarkers.prevalence: Elevated in most advanced HGSC; overall ~80% of epithelial ovarian cancers
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic workup (ROMA/RMI score with HE4); response monitoring (GCIG criteria); recurrence surveillance. Not a screening test in general population

biomarkers.name: HE4 (human epididymis protein 4)
biomarkers.clinical_use: ROMA (Risk of Ovarian Malignancy Algorithm) — combined CA-125/HE4/menopausal status; helps distinguish benign from malignant pelvic mass

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; no validated standard prevalence/use threshold in HGSC
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not an established routine predictive biomarker in HGSC; IO monotherapy has limited benefit and combinations remain under investigation

biomarkers.name: MSI / dMMR
biomarkers.clinical_use: Rare in HGSC; if positive, pembrolizumab (tissue-agnostic)

biomarkers.name: Folate receptor alpha (FRα)
biomarkers.prevalence: High expression is common in HGSC; approximately one-third to over one-half may meet assay-defined high expression depending on scoring method/trial population
biomarkers.clinical_use: Mirvetuximab soravtansine (ADC targeting FRα) — approved for FRα-positive platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer using companion diagnostic testing

biomarkers.name: MRD-ctDNA
biomarkers.clinical_use: Emerging role for MRD detection after primary therapy; not standard yet

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Papillary, glandular, or solid architecture; high-grade nuclei with prominent nucleoli; slit-like glandular spaces; psammoma bodies common
variants: SET pattern (solid/pseudoendometrioid/transitional-like — associated with BRCA dysfunction and often better chemotherapy response)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: By definition high-grade (2-tier system replaces older 3-tier)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable — TIL density is prognostic; BRCA-mutant tumours often more inflamed; HRD-positive subset may be more IO-responsive
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Desmoplastic peritoneal implants; often extensive omental caking

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Fallopian tube secretory epithelial cells at fimbriated end (via serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma — STIC lesion) rather than ovarian surface epithelium
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — Müllerian duct derivative (fallopian tube from paramesonephric duct)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Serous (tubal-type) differentiation with PAX8+, WT1+, CK7+ (Müllerian phenotype); TP53 mutations are near-universal, with 'p53 signature' and STIC lesions identified in the tubal precursor pathway
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Modern paradigm: 'ovarian' HGSC actually often originates from fallopian tube fimbria; TP53 alteration is an early event in progression from p53 signature/STIC to invasive HGSC, with widespread chromosomal instability and frequent HRD
